text: {"action": "reply", "content": "Our general return policy for vacuum cleaners allows customers to return items within 30 days of delivery, provided the order status is 'delivered'. You would need to confirm the order ID and the items to be returned. The refund will be processed to the original payment method or an existing gift card. After confirmation, the order status will change to 'return requested', and you will receive an email with instructions on how to return the items. Please note that the item must be in its original condition and packaging for a full refund to be issued."}
